body:
**SEBI settlement order (primary source)** — [SEBI Settlement Order SO/AA/EFD2/2023-24/7081, 25 May 2023](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/may-2023/1685095933750.pdf)
- Applicants: Mansun Consultancy Pvt Ltd (incorporated 30 Jun 2017; the Sundars own 50% each), P R Sundar, and Mangayarkarasi Sundar.
- SEBI acted on two references alleging advisory without registration. His website prsundar.blogspot.com (posts since 27 Aug 2013) had an "Advisory" tab saying: "Daily calls on Telegram: We will be giving daily calls on what positions to take, adjustments, etc." It also carried a Razorpay payment link, and the bank KYC described the business as "share marketing consultancy".
- A sample of January 2021 recommendations was found to be "investment advice" under the IA Regulations 2013. The alleged violation was Section 12(1) of the SEBI Act read with Reg 3(1) of the IA Regulations.
- Fees collected: ₹4,36,42,503 via Razorpay plus ₹23,53,260 by direct credit, for a total of ₹4,59,95,763.
- Timeline: SCN 17 May 2022 and supplementary SCN 8 Nov 2022. Settlement applications 9 Dec 2022, revised terms 2 Feb 2023, HPAC 22 Feb 2023, approved by Whole Time Members 3 Apr 2023, order passed 25 May 2023.
- Terms: ₹15,60,000 each (₹46,80,000 total), plus disgorgement of ₹6,07,69,863 (fees plus ₹1,47,74,100 interest at 12% from 1 Jun 2020 to 2 Feb 2023). They must refrain from buying, selling or dealing in securities for one year from the order. The settlement was "without admitting or denying the findings of fact and conclusions of law".
- Media framed it as "In a first, SEBI acts against finfluencer" — [Zee Business](https://zeebiz.com/market-news/news-in-a-first-sebi-bans-finfluencer-pr-sundar-for-violating-investment-adviser-norms-mansun-fine-settlement-237403); [Storyboard18](https://www.storyboard18.com/how-it-works/in-a-first-sebi-acts-against-finfluencer-pr-sundar-options-trader-not-allowed-to-trade-for-a-year-8483.htm). The probe was reported in Nov 2022 — [Business Standard, 29 Nov 2022](https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/sebi-launches-investigations-against-finfluencer-purisai-rajamani-sundar-122112901285_1.html). Sundar reportedly called it a two-year-old matter from when he was associated with a SEBI-registered advisory company (his own framing) — [via search summary of BS](https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/sebi-launches-investigations-against-finfluencer-purisai-rajamani-sundar-122112901285_1.html). Online critics mocked "bad calls and heavy fees" — [Business Today, 26 May 2023](https://businesstoday.in/markets/top-story/story/karma-finally-got-hold-of-pr-sundar-say-netizens-as-finfluencer-faces-sebis-wrath-383063-2023-05-26)
- Later finfluencer cases show the trend: "Baap of Chart" (Nasiruddin Ansari) was barred and ordered to refund ₹17 crore — [BQ Prime](https://www.bqprime.com/law-and-policy/sebi-bars-baap-of-chart-finfluencer-orders-rs-17-crore-refund). In Dec 2025 an interim order against Avadhut Sathe's trading academy impounded more than ₹546 crore — [JusCorpus](https://www.juscorpus.com/educators-or-unlicensed-advisers/)
